sloka: अलम्बुसा मिश्रकेशी पुण्डरीकाथ वामना ।उपानृत्यंस्तु भरत भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥ २.९१.४६॥
transliteration: alambusā miśrakeśī puṇḍarīkātha vāmanā ।upānṛtyaṁstu bharata bharadvājasya śāsanāt ॥ 2.91.46॥

translations.english: There along with Narada, Tumburu and Gopa, distinguished kings of the gandharvas, looking bright like the Sun, began to sing in the presence of Bharata.
